title: UCI Online Retail Dataset: Scope and Limitations
content: The UCI Online Retail dataset contains invoice-line transactions from a UK-based non-store retailer, covering 1 December 2010 through 9 December 2011. Its fields include invoice number, stock code, product description, quantity, invoice date, unit price in pounds sterling, customer ID, and customer country. An invoice number beginning with C denotes a cancellation. Customer IDs are missing for some records. This is one retailer's historical microdata; it is not a representative sample of all UK retail and should not be directly compared with aggregate national retail indices without accounting for differences in population, period, currency, and measurement.
attribution: Chen, D. (2015). Online Retail. UCI Machine Learning Repository.

title: ONS Retail Sales: August 2026 Context
content: The Office for National Statistics reported that Great Britain retail sales volumes rose 0.9% in the three months to August 2026 compared with the three months to May 2026. Online spending values rose 1.9% over the same three-month comparison and 10.1% compared with the three months to August 2025. ONS cautions that monthly retail growth can be volatile and should be considered alongside rolling three-month movements. The bulletin describes aggregate national statistics, not the individual retailer in the UCI Online Retail transaction dataset; it can provide broad context but does not establish a cause for changes in that retailer's sales.
attribution: Office for National Statistics, Retail sales, Great Britain: August 2026, released 18 September 2026.
